items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Oh, yeah, I made some records with Lil Armstrong. I made some records with her.

ctx.x: And he said Hamp used to do this before he started playing anything. He went around beating on curbstones and --

Right, right, right, right. And then, when we first come to Chicago, in -- around '23, was the heyday of Lil Armstrong, who was from Memphis, and she and my sister were very, very close friends there, they were real buddy-buddy girls.
Did your sister know Lil in Memphis?
